verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.gladia.io/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a curated product index. Docs pages are also served as Markdown (.md) with a header directing agents to fetch the llms.txt index, and the docs-1 through docs-13 entries are drawn from that file. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or single-file full-docs dump, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at any probed path.
